headline: Kai, this morning's CPI print decides whether September's coin flip lands on a hike.
subline: July inflation hits at 8:30 ET with hike odds at 50-50, oil holds near $83 on the Hormuz stalemate, and Cisco and Cerebras headline today's earnings.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:45 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: July CPI due at 8:30, consensus 3.4 percent
items.sentence: Kiplinger's preview puts consensus at +0.1% on the month and 3.4% on the year with core at 2.5%, after a 20% July oil surge reversed June's negative energy readings.

items.title: September is a coin flip until this print
items.sentence: CME FedWatch has hike-or-hold odds at 50-50, per Kiplinger, and Schwab's morning note says an in-line reading could trim the hike case.

items.title: Ten-year holds at 4.68 percent before CPI
items.sentence: Trading Economics shows the 10-year easing 0.01 percentage points to 4.68% this morning, treading water until the report.

items.title: Oil holds above $82 as Hormuz talks stall
items.sentence: Babypips' recap says deal hopes dimmed after Iran's security council rejected full-reopening terms and Trump demanded reparations; Schwab pegs WTI at $82.59 this morning.

items.title: Cisco, Coherent, Nebius and Cerebras report today
items.sentence: Yahoo Finance's live blog flags the four on today's docket, with Coherent already down 14% Monday on what Schwab called pre-earnings profit taking.

items.title: Marine held in Russia freed after four years
items.sentence: NPR reports the former Marine's release from what his family and US officials called wrongful imprisonment on disputed charges.

items.title: Colombia quake toll reaches 181 as rescues strain
items.sentence: At least 181 people are dead and 2,595 injured from the magnitude 7.4 earthquake, per NPR, with the response straining Colombia's new government.

items.title: Trump pivots back to sanctions on Iran
items.sentence: NPR reports the administration is returning to economic pressure as the military and diplomatic tracks to end its war have stalled.

items.title: Syrian court sentences Assad to death in absentia
items.sentence: The former president and his brother were convicted of crimes against humanity from the civil war, per NPR.

items.title: Turkey passes conditional pardons for PKK militants
items.sentence: Parliament approved the pardon-like bill covering thousands of militants as part of the Kurdish peace initiative, per NPR.

items.title: Nvidia lines up $500 billion for AI buildout
items.sentence: Tech Startups reports financing platforms with Apollo, Blackstone and BlackRock to fund customers' AI infrastructure, easing the capital bottleneck.

items.title: OpenAI ships GPT-5.6-Cyber for vetted defenders
items.sentence: The restricted model gives authorized security professionals advanced vulnerability-discovery tools with safeguards against misuse, per Tech Startups.

items.title: Intel upsizes share sale, raises $19.7 billion
items.sentence: Tech Startups says the offering grew from $15 billion to $20 billion to fund fab expansion and AI-processor ambitions; Schwab notes the stock slipped 1% on it.

items.title: Unitree's Shanghai IPO draws 8,000x retail demand
items.sentence: The humanoid-robot maker priced at 150.80 yuan to raise $904 million, per Tech Startups, which calls the demand a sign of extraordinary enthusiasm for robotics.

items.title: Anthropic adds watermarks to Claude text and images
items.sentence: The machine-readable marks survive copying and light edits and are built for incoming AI-transparency rules, per Tech Startups.
